items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: We played there on several occasions and those girls used to play with us up in there.

ctx.x: Would they ever play with your band? What you mean white?

Yeah white. Well sure we played at the harmony club then and they played, that's where at the harmony club, Jackson Cinchaw. Yeah that's it. We played there on several occasions and those girls used to play with us up in there. You know that guy.
